title: AggregationLane
description: Per-variety aggregation policy mode — the lane a SignalVariety travels (or does not travel) when flows aggregate upward from a private context. Declared by adoption-time policy contracts; enforced at the aggregation boundary (bounds_validator check family), never upstream. Design home: genesis/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-31-care-aggregation-adoption-policy-floor-design.md (§3-4).

core.rationale: k-anonymous = joins threshold-gated rollups (k and window are aggregator config, not lane vocabulary); count-only = magnitude stripped to presence-of-signal before aggregation; after-graduation-only = leaves origin reach only via an explicit graduation ceremony; suppressed = never leaves origin reach. 'suppressed' is the bare-adoption default for every variety — absence of policy aggregates nothing.
